C1.rule: Mechanical, one owned file, fully specified

C2.rule: Bounded implementation or tests, one or two owned files and their tests

C3.rule: Cross-module design; changes a contract every project inherits

C4.rule: Planning, merging, reconciling, another project's real data, a sponsor decision

phases.name: Mandatory standard
phases.goal: Every session the sponsor gives /standard follows one structure and speaks one language; the PhotoVault app and engine first.
phases.exit: S-01 to S-06 merged; the app and engine each report 12 of 12 on conformance.

items.title: /standard: the sponsor's mandatory command
items.what: A user-level skill (skills/standard, linked into ~/.claude/skills) the sponsor types in any session: the session states its refactor stage now, then refactors to one 12-item checklist shared by every project.
items.done: Linked at user level; the PhotoVault app and engine each reply with a refactor stage.

log.evidence: written on p21 from the sponsor's ruling (A-01, A-02)

items.title: Proposal template and bin/new-proposal
items.what: templates/proposal.html in the checked shape (status meta, <ol class="decisions">, id="decided" block, exceptions) and bin/new-proposal NN-or-next "title" writing the page and its ledger; proposalcheck and tracker validate pass on the result.
items.done: A new proposal in a scratch project passes proposalcheck and tracker validate unedited.

items.title: proposalcheck: no unchecked proposal pages above the legacy floor
items.what: A numbered proposal page without a status meta is a violation, except at or below .common-rules.json proposals_legacy_through; project.py validates the key.
items.done: App 72/75/76 and engine 77 are violations until the floor is declared; declared, they are grandfathered.

items.title: bin/conformance: the 12-item checklist, measured
items.what: Reports each of /standard's 12 items as holds / does not hold / waiting on common-rules for a project, with a one-line why; exit 1 while any item does not hold.
items.done: Run read-only on the PhotoVault app and engine, it names what each still lacks.

items.title: Hooks from a parent start folder
items.what: A session started above its projects (PhotoVault/ holds app/ and engine/) still gets the session-start card: the hook lists each project below with its card state and names /warmup --project.
items.done: A scratch parent folder with two projects prints one line per project at start and after compaction.

items.title: Templates and CLAUDE-workflow name the standard
items.what: lead-prompt.md gains a version marker and a Proposals section (new proposals via bin/new-proposal, owners, requests); CLAUDE-workflow.md gets a short section: the standard is mandatory, /standard adopts it, /warmup starts every session.
items.done: Template tests pin the marker and sections.

items.title: PhotoVault app on the standard
items.what: The app session runs /standard, names its refactor stage, and refactors to the checklist.

items.title: PhotoVault engine on the standard
items.what: The engine session runs /standard, names its refactor stage, and refactors to the checklist.

asks.quote: Yes. This is mandatory. It's not optional. I want them to follow the same structure, and they should refactor once they reach the... they should tell me, okay, at what stage when the current tasks are finished, they will refactor it. And I want every... both of those sessions to speak the common language and handle things in the same way. It's mandatory. It's not optional.

And I want this to be a standard way of proceeding ahead for other projects as well whenever I create a session at a user level. I want the... once I use the command, I want the sessions to accept it and do whatever needs to be done to follow the standard way.
